# Allow all web crawlers to access most content
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Disallow RSS feeds (they should not be indexed directly)
Disallow: /*.xml$
Disallow: */rss.xml
Disallow: */feed.xml
Disallow: */rss

# Disallow blog tag pages until the server errors are fixed
Disallow: /tag/

# Specify sitemap locations
Sitemap: https://lckhp.org/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://blog.lckhp.org/sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://lckhp.org/blog-sitemap.xml
Sitemap: https://lckhp.org/members-sitemap.xml
